scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lightspeed-ai/client && npm run build --workspace @lightspeed-ai/configurator-mcp && npm run build --workspace @lightspeed-ai/platform-web && npm run build:demo --workspace @lightspeed-ai/platform-web
scripts.check: npm run check:dev && npm run check:identity && npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm run test:consumers && npm run build
scripts.check:ci: npm run check && npm run test:build && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:release-packaging
scripts.check:dev: bash -n dev.sh scripts/dev/env.sh scripts/dev/lib/common.sh scripts/dev/infra/*.sh && node --check scripts/dev/stack.mjs && node --test scripts/dev/*.test.mjs && ./dev.sh --help >/dev/null && LIGHTSPEED_CHANNELS_CONNECTORS= node scripts/dev/stack.mjs --plan infra >/dev/null && LIGHTSPEED_CHANNELS_CONNECTORS= node scripts/dev/stack.mjs --plan runtime >/dev/null && LIGHTSPEED_CHANNELS_CONNECTORS= node scripts/dev/stack.mjs --plan platform >/dev/null && LIGHTSPEED_CHANNELS_CONNECTORS= node scripts/dev/stack.mjs --plan demo >/dev/null && LIGHTSPEED_CHANNELS_CONNECTORS= node scripts/dev/stack.mjs --plan full >/dev/null
scripts.check:generated: npm run check:generated --workspace @lightspeed-ai/client && npm run check:generated --workspace @lightspeed-ai/configurator-mcp && node platform/scripts/generate-config-reference.mjs && node platform/scripts/generate-method-roles.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- platform/web/src/lib/profile-config-reference.ts platform/backend/src/routes/method-roles.ts
scripts.test:release-packaging: npm --prefix clients/typescript ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix platform/configurator-mcp ci --ignore-scripts && scripts/release/stage-runtimes.sh
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @lightspeed-ai/connectors && npm run typecheck --workspace @lightspeed-ai/platform-web && npm run typecheck --workspace @lightspeed-ai/client && npm run typecheck --workspace @lightspeed-ai/configurator-mcp
